note: What generate_audio.py makes with ElevenLabs. Speakers get a voice from Voice Design once (voice_id is written back here); their lines are read from the mod's English texts in the C# source and the Norwegian ones in Translations/Norwegian.json. Effects and music are made from the prompts.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Asbjorn
speakers.description: A warm, friendly middle-aged Norse farmer and coastal trader. Round, hearty male voice with a gentle Scandinavian accent, cheerful and welcoming.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Gunnar
speakers.description: A gruff, weathered Norse woodsman trader in his fifties. Deep, slightly rough male voice with a Scandinavian accent, dry humour, steady and calm.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Ragnhild
speakers.description: A shrewd, no-nonsense Norse woman trader from the marshes, around fifty. Firm, slightly husky female voice with a Scandinavian accent, wry and practical.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Hallvard
speakers.description: A hardy old Norse mountain trader. Strong, clear, booming male voice with a Scandinavian accent, proud and good-natured, used to shouting over the wind.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Sigrid
speakers.description: A lively, confident young Norse woman merchant of the golden plains, around thirty. Bright, energetic female voice with a Scandinavian accent, quick and charming.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Ylva
speakers.description: A mysterious Norse woman trader from the misty lands, around forty. Low, soft, slightly breathy female voice with a Scandinavian accent, calm and secretive.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Brand
speakers.description: A battle-scarred Norse trader from the burning ash lands. Very deep, smoky, gravelly male voice with a Scandinavian accent, intense and blunt.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Froydis
speakers.description: A composed Norse woman trader from the frozen far north, around sixty. Cool, crisp, slightly hoarse female voice with a Scandinavian accent, measured and dignified.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Ulf
speakers.description: A rugged Norse hunter who lives in the woods, around forty-five. Rough, low male voice with a Scandinavian accent, relaxed, proud of his kills, a little boastful.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Skipper
speakers.description: A loud, seasoned Norse ship captain shouting orders on deck. Strong, carrying male voice with a Scandinavian accent, energetic and commanding.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Raider One
speakers.description: An undead draugr pirate raider. Raspy, hollow, gravelly male voice with a Scandinavian accent, menacing and cruel, as if from the grave.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Raider Two
speakers.description: A wild undead viking sea raider. Harsh, hissing, cackling male voice with a Scandinavian accent, bloodthirsty and mocking.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Raider Chief
speakers.description: An undead draugr jarl commanding a ghost ship. Very deep, booming, echoing male voice with a Scandinavian accent, ancient and terrifying.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Voice of the Hilt
speakers.description: An ancient, mystical, otherworldly voice of a legendary sword speaking to its bearer. Deep, resonant, calm and solemn, slightly echoing, genderless and timeless, with a faint Scandinavian accent.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Husvette
speakers.description: A tiny, very old Norse house spirit, a gnome-like tomte with a red cap. Crackly, warm, slightly grumpy and mumbling old male voice with a Scandinavian accent, kindly underneath.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Munin
speakers.description: Odin's talking raven of memory. A raspy, croaking, sharp and clever voice like a bird that has learned to speak, quick and a little eerie, with a Scandinavian accent.

speakers.name: WhiteHilt Storm Voice
speakers.description: A hollow, ghostly voice calling out through a howling storm, as if from far away in thick fog. Breathy, echoing, sorrowful and eerie, neither clearly male nor female, ageless, with a faint Scandinavian accent.

effects.name: sfx_storm_thunder
effects.prompt: A massive thunder strike right overhead: a sharp, deafening explosive crack splitting the sky, then a deep heavy rumble rolling away. Realistic, powerful, cinematic. No rain, no music.

effects.name: sfx_storm_thunder_far
effects.prompt: Distant thunder far away over the hills: a long low rolling rumble that swells and fades. Realistic, no rain, no music.

effects.name: sfx_storm_warning
effects.prompt: An ominous change in the weather: distant thunder rolling over the horizon and a cold gust of wind rising, then a long low viking warning horn blown far away. No music.

effects.name: sfx_storm_ignite
effects.prompt: A burst of fire catching on clothes: a sudden whoosh of flames igniting and crackling. Short, no music.

effects.name: amb_storm_rain
effects.prompt: A violent storm outdoors: torrential heavy rain lashing down, strong gusting wind howling through trees and branches creaking. Steady and continuous, no thunder cracks, no music, no voices.

effects.name: amb_storm_blizzard
effects.prompt: A fierce mountain blizzard: howling icy wind gusts, blowing snow hissing across ice and rock, a bitter roaring gale. Steady and continuous, no music, no voices.

effects.name: amb_storm_sand
effects.prompt: A desert sandstorm: a roaring dry wind and the constant hiss of blowing sand and grit whipping past, gusts swelling and falling. Steady and continuous, no music, no voices.

effects.name: amb_storm_mist
effects.prompt: A freezing fog storm: a low moaning wind in dense mist, eerie creaking of frozen branches, faint icy whistling. Cold and oppressive, steady and continuous, no music, no voices.

effects.name: amb_storm_sea
effects.prompt: A storm at sea: heavy rain on open water, large waves crashing, howling wind, a wooden ship creaking under strain. Steady and continuous, no thunder, no music, no voices.

effects.name: amb_storm_fire
effects.prompt: A firestorm: roaring walls of flame, crackling burning embers raining down, hot rushing wind gusts and a deep volcanic rumble. Steady and continuous, no music, no voices.

effects.name: sfx_storm_strike
effects.prompt: A lightning bolt striking the ground right beside you: an instant deafening electric snap and sizzle, a blinding crack, then a heavy explosive boom and debris falling. No rain, no music.

effects.name: sfx_storm_static
effects.prompt: Electric static crackling and buzzing in the air, rising quickly in pitch and intensity, the tense moment right before a lightning strike. No music.

effects.name: sfx_storm_treecrack
effects.prompt: A large tree giving way in a storm: loud groaning and creaking wood, a sharp splitting crack of the trunk, then the tree crashing down through branches and hitting the ground with a heavy thud. No music.

effects.name: sfx_storm_steps
effects.prompt: Slow heavy footsteps crunching through snow and frozen mud right behind you, three or four steps coming closer, then they stop. Close and eerie, no wind, no music, no voices.

effects.name: sfx_storm_whisper
effects.prompt: Ghostly whispering right at your ear: several hushed, breathy voices murmuring over each other, no words that can be made out, fading away into wind. Eerie, close, no music.

effects.name: sfx_dark_gutter
effects.prompt: Torch flames in a stone crypt guttering and sputtering in a sudden cold draft, flickering and wavering, with a low eerie moan of air through the tunnels. No music, no voices.

effects.name: sfx_dark_out
effects.prompt: Every torch in a stone crypt snuffed out at once by a cold gust: a sharp whoosh, flames dying with a hiss, then deep silence with a faint low rumble. No music, no voices.

effects.name: sfx_dark_return
effects.prompt: Torches in a stone crypt flaring back to life one after another: soft whooshes of fire catching and crackling. No music, no voices.

effects.name: sfx_dark_scrape
effects.prompt: Something unseen slowly scraping long claws along a stone wall in a pitch-black cave, close by, then stopping. Eerie, no music, no voices.

effects.name: sfx_dark_breath
effects.prompt: Slow, heavy, wet breathing of something unseen right behind you in a pitch-black cave, a few breaths and a low growl in its throat. Eerie, no music, no words.

effects.name: sfx_dark_heartbeat
effects.prompt: A loud, fast human heartbeat: heavy muffled thudding as if heard from inside your own chest, steady and continuous. No music, no breathing.

music.name: music_tradingpost

music.name: music_seabattle

music.name: music_bigbeast
